steps.en: Install the desktop package for your OS
steps.zh: 安装对应系统的桌面包

steps.en: Create a database connection with its address, credentials and any SSH jump host
steps.zh: 填写数据库地址、凭据和所需跳板机

steps.en: Connect to the database and show its objects in the workspace
steps.zh: 连接数据库，在工作区展示对象

steps.en: Open the SQL editor and run a query
steps.zh: 打开 SQL 编辑器并执行查询

steps.en: Show query results in the data grid beside your other operations tabs
steps.zh: 在其他操作标签旁展示查询结果表格

value.en: Inspect database results in the same desktop workspace as server terminals and remote files
value.zh: 在服务器终端和远程文件所在的桌面工作区查看数据库结果
